summary: Off-registry dependency sourced from mutable GitHub branch tarball
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `node-net-pool` as a tarball of the `main` branch of a personal GitHub repository (`https://github.com/trktgq0wbre1/node-net-pool/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz`) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches that URL with no version pin, no commit SHA, and no integrity check, and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched bytes. The dependency-hosting account (`trktgq0wbre1`) is unrelated to the publishing identity. lib/cache.js additionally performs a top-level guarded `require('node-net-pool')` reached during normal `initMFA()` usage, so any top-level side effects in the fetched module also execute when the library is loaded. Whoever controls that GitHub account controls code executed on every installer's machine, and the delivered bytes can be swapped at any time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
